integrity: A complete dimension-free argument is given; the included exact-integer program performs finite independent combinatorial checks only, not an infinite proof. Self-review is recorded; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact identity concerns ordinary and finite weighted-direction illumination of the type-D root polytope in every integer dimension at least four; the three-dimensional cuboctahedron is a separately treated known-direction-count boundary case. It does not assert uniqueness of optimal direction systems or any quantitative point-source-cost bound. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact ordinary and fractional illumination of type-\(D_d\) root polytopes
